charts.title: TOI-6564 b: orbits around TOI-6564
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6564's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6564 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Battley et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.549g1053B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BATTLEY_ET_AL_2026): P 3.985413 d

charts.title: TOI-6564 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6564 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (100, 101, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 453668803, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 12 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 18-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
